introHtml: Rainbow-colored buttons, stickers, and patches let you show support for LGBTQ+ inclusion, diversity, and unity in a bold, visible way. Whether you're planning a Pride parade, launching an internal ERG campaign, or creating branded giveaways for a community event, the rainbow spectrum turns everyday promotional items into statements. These vibrant pieces work well on backpacks, lanyards, and apparel, and they screen-print or die-stamp cleanly. Ordering in bulk keeps per-unit costs low while maximizing your message's reach.
